item.title: HeyBuds 0.6.0
item.description:
# HeyBuds 0.6.0
新增 55 款耳机的初步支持，保留现有界面与功能。
- **Xiaomi / Redmi：16 款明确型号。** 10 款按型号接入降噪、EQ、手势等控制，6 款仅基础信息／电量；系统未上报的电量保持未知。[逐型号功能](https://github.com/abaichuan1017/HeyBuds/blob/v0.6.0/docs/XIAOMI_SUPPORT.md) - **其他扩展：39 款。** 包含 Soundcore、MOMENTUM、JBL、HONOR，以及更多 Sony、Galaxy Buds、Bose QC35 和 Nothing/CMF 型号。[功能与限制](https://github.com/abaichuan1017/HeyBuds/blob/v0.6.0/docs/DESKTOP_EXPANSION.md)
实际功能取决于型号、固件和设备响应；新增型号的 HeyBuds/macOS 实机兼容性仍待验证。
Initial support for 55 additional models: 16 explicit Xiaomi / Redmi profiles and 39 models across Soundcore, Sennheiser, JBL, HONOR, Sony, Samsung, Bose and Nothing/CMF. Existing interface and features are retained. Features vary by model, firmware and valid device responses; hardware compatibility for the newly added models remains unverified.
Apple Silicon · macOS 26+
### 致谢 / Thanks
- **Xiaomi / Redmi**：[BudsLink](https://github.com/maniacx/BudsLink)、[MiBudsClient](https://github.com/CesurPolat/MiBudsClient)、[buds-ctl](https://github.com/LeoLee0812/buds-ctl)、[redmi-buds-bar](https://github.com/robin-liquidium/redmi-buds-bar)、[MiPods](https://github.com/JackWPP/MiPods)。 - **Soundcore**：[OpenSCQ30](https://github.com/Oppzippy/OpenSCQ30)。 - **Sennheiser**：[momentum4-control](https://github.com/Ariazonaa/momentum4-control)。 - **JBL**：[Omaphones](https://github.com/ncr/omarchy-headphones)、[JBL Control](https://github.com/AhmadRun/jbl-control)、[770NC Windows Controller](https://github.com/Xeo23/JBL-Tune-770NC-Windows-Controller)。 - **HONOR**：[OpenFreebuds](https://github.com/melianmiko/OpenFreebuds)。 - **Sony / Bose**：[SonyHeadphonesClient](https://github.com/mos9527/SonyHeadphonesClient)、[Sound Connect](https://github.com/aecca/sound-connect)、Omaphones。 - **Samsung**：[GalaxyBudsClient](https://github.com/timschneeb/GalaxyBudsClient)。 - **Nothing / CMF**：[ear-web](https://github.com/radiance-project/ear-web) 与 Omaphones（协议事实参考；未采用许可声明冲突的实现代码）。
